subject: chemistry
content:
An equal volume of a reducing agent is titrated separately with 1M KMnO<sub>4</sub> in acid neutral  and alkaline media. The volumes of KMnO<sub>4</sub> required are 20 ml. in acid 33.4 ml. neutral  and 100 ml in alkaline media. Find out the oxidation state of manganese in each reduction product. Give the balanced equations for all three half reactions. Find out the volume of 
 1M K<sub>2</sub>Cr<sub>2</sub>O<sub>7</sub> consumed; if the same volume of the reducing agent is titrated in acid medium.
